'''Jessal Yu''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] who, along with [[Frela Tarm|Dr. Frela Tarm]], helped develop the [[Nanovirus|nanokillers]] that targeted the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]].<ref name="Fate of Jedi" />
